title: Sacred Steps: extending kindness, step by step
excerpt: Volunteers from across the branch offered refreshments and cleaned the premises for devotees on their journey to venerate the Sacred Tooth Relic.
content:
Sacred Steps was a heartfelt initiative dedicated to supporting devotees on their spiritual journey to venerate the Tooth Relic.

Organised with love and care, the event involved offering refreshments and cleaning the premises, creating a meaningful experience of service. With the support of generous donors and dedicated volunteers from the Student Branch, WIE, ComSoc, CS, IAS and PES, every smile and blessing shared made it truly special.
